sloka: भरतेनात्मना चाहम् शपे ते मनुजाधिप ।यथा नान्येन तुष्येयमृते रामविवासनात् ॥२-१२-४९॥
transliteration: bharatenātmanā cāham śape te manujādhipa ।yathā nānyena tuṣyeyamṛte rāmavivāsanāt ॥2-12-49॥

translations.english: O king, I swear on Bharata and on my own life that nothing less than Rama's banishment will satisfy me.
